stem: A chemical is stored in a location where a leak could contact an incompatible material listed in the supplied storage procedure. What should the technician do?
choices: Move or segregate the material according to the approved compatibility/storage procedure and report the condition
Open both containers to compare odors
Mix small amounts to see whether they react
rationale: Chemical compatibility controls are preventive. The technician should use the approved storage/segregation process rather than experimentally testing compatibility.
